017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728;
018
019import java.util.*;
020
021/**
022 * The resolved MCP operation an {@link McpOperationScopeResolver} decides required scopes for (SEP-2350 per-operation
023 * step-up).
024 *
025 * <p>
026 * Carries the JSON-RPC {@code method} (e.g. {@code tools/call}), the operation {@code name} (the tool / prompt name or
027 * resource URI, as returned by the revision's routing-name derivation), and an opaque read-only view of the raw JSON-RPC
028 * request {@code params}.  A static per-operation scope map keys on {@code (method, name)}; the {@code params} view is the
029 * seam a future dynamic resolver could consult (READY-312f Q-c: not built for 10.0).
030 *
031 * <p>
032 * {@code params} is the <em>raw</em> JSON-RPC {@code params} object, not the unwrapped tool-call arguments: for a
033 * {@code tools/call} request it is {@code {"name":<tool>, "arguments":{...}}}, so a resolver reads the tool arguments via
034 * {@code ctx.params().get("arguments")} rather than treating {@code params} as the argument map itself.
035 *
036 * @param method The JSON-RPC method.  Never {@code null}.
037 * @param name The operation name (tool/prompt name or resource URI), or {@code null} for methods without one.
038 * @param params A read-only view of the raw JSON-RPC request params.  Never {@code null}.
039 * @since 10.0.0
040 */
041public record McpOperationContext(String method, String name, Map<String,Object> params) {
042
043   /**
044    * Compact constructor enforcing a non-null method and defensively copying the params to a read-only map.
045    */
046   public McpOperationContext {
047      Objects.requireNonNull(method, "method");
048      params = params == null ? Map.of() : Collections.unmodifiableMap(new LinkedHashMap<>(params));
049   }
050}
